segments.text:
V. 22.
The eye is the lamp of the body—And what the eye is to the Body, the Intention is to the Soul. We may obſerve with what exact Propriety our LORD places Purity of Intention, between worldly Deſires and worldly Cares, either of which directly tend to deſtroy it. If thine eye be ſingle—Singly fixed on GOD and Heaven, thy whole Soul will be full of Holineſs and Happineſs. If thy eye be evil—Not ſingle, aming at any Thing elſe.
